\section*{Data and Code Availability}
Pre-registrations, protocols, frozen records, the register of corrections and the regeneration script are at https://github.com/gadevito/motion-p1, under \texttt{protocol/\allowbreak{}paper4/\allowbreak{}} and \texttt{paper4/\allowbreak{}}, with a README that maps every experiment to its pre-registration, frozen code and frozen record. The per-cell predictions and checkpoints of Part B will be archived at Zenodo [ref: Zenodo record of Paper 4, to be created]. External data: the Traffic4cast benchmark ~\cite{neun2023t4c}; the Madrid loop and Austin radar data as used by the project report ~\cite{motion2026uc04}, with the fingerprints of every file in the repository.
